_about: The Bestiary's rebuilt creatures, written in the card Structure (book/cards/card-structure.md). The record: book/bestiary-design.md; each creature's own: book/cards/orc-warrior-redesign.md. Foundry reads these laid over ../bestiary.json (load.mjs FOUNDRY_OVERLAY): a rebuilt creature's old cards leave Foundry (they stay in ../bestiary.json as fixtures for the tests of the machinery they exercised). 'npc' names the creature the card belongs to; 'book': false, since Chapter 14 is not rewritten yet. The numbers are the Default Standard's (bestiary-design.md, decisions 12 to 15); no number assumes a class.

cards.name: Hamstringing Axe
cards.flavor: The orc cuts low, at the leg that would carry you away.

foundry.automationNote: a Basic attack (the exploding die, the Critical's 1d10!); Hindered (EoT) when a Tier 3 lands.

cards.name: Barbed Javelin
cards.flavor: The orc throws a short spear that stays in the wound.

foundry.automationNote: a Basic attack (the exploding die, the Critical's 1d10!; it shares the At-will count with the axe); Lingering 1d4 (Bo/In) when a Tier 3 lands. The Setup's draw is text: an NPC's items are flavor.

cards.name: War Howl
cards.flavor: The orc throws its head back and howls, and the sound gets into your bones.

foundry.automationNote: the 2 Emanation around the orc, each enemy's Mind Save against its Power DC and its damage; Vulnerable 1 (EoT) on a Tier 1.

cards.name: Blood for Blood
cards.flavor: The wound only makes it angrier.

body.label: Trigger
body.text: The target deals Vigor damage to the orc (the blow that makes it Bloodied counts).

body.label: Effect
body.text: The orc Advances up to 2 toward the target, then makes a Basic attack against it with 1 Bane.

foundry.automationNote: Use: the Advance (the button) and a Basic attack with 1 Bane (the button: the axe; for the javelin, use it from the sheet and add the Bane). NOT offered by itself yet: the GM uses it from the sheet when a creature within 2 squares deals Vigor damage to the Bloodied orc (the moment 'you take damage', with its pool and its state, is in foundry-backlog.md).

sub: Advances up to 2 toward the target
makes a Basic attack against it with 1 Bane
makes a @Use[Basic Attack|banes:1|label:Basic attack (1 Bane)] against it

cards.name: Cornered
cards.flavor: Hurt, it stops fencing and starts throwing its weight around.

body.label: Passive
body.text: While the orc is Bloodied, its [[Shove]] gains 1 Boon.

foundry.automationNote: text: the GM adds the Boon in the roll dialog when a Bloodied orc Shoves (a Boon on a Basic Action while in a state is in foundry-backlog.md).
